# Environment

The razorwind package uses various configuration parameters to control the behavior of the application. These parameters can be provided as environment variables when the application is run, or they can be defined in a `config.json` file in the application configuration directory.

## Configuration



The below list of configuration parameters are **not** considered sensitive or confidential. Any values provided in these variables will be available in plain text locally.
